root_choices.source: Original fixed Pallox50 pairs/all100rawframes, no dropping/qualityfilter. Original pair/view/split/onephysicalbinfamily maintained; V84seed separate.
root_choices.tile_order: original cohort row order, before then after, L ascending, y ascending, x ascending
root_choices.in_frame_query: all centres satisfy0<=x<W and0<=y<H; window may include padding. Report valid native integer-pixel count/fraction separately.
root_choices.input_geometry_metadata: sourceimagepath/SHA/nativeHW,pair/view/split/family,query_xy,L only; no q selection byGT. No native8slot/context42 fabrication.

prior_exposure_KO: 기존 Pallox cue/teacher/이미지 감사에서 GT와 공개 RGB를 이미 보았다. 이번 선택은 고정 GT-free 기하 함수이며 blind protocol이라고 주장하지 않는다.
permitted_image_access: Read PNG fixed24-byte header only for nativeW/H. Do not decode RGB or read tensor/pixelbody. Image SHA copied from immutable source cohort metadata; no new image pixel/hash scan.
stages: Freeze this protocol + generated edge/math fixtures + builder code.
Build all100frames and all grid tile input metadata. Seal input manifest BEFORE any proposed cue GT join.
After input seal, read immutable V85proposed294 GT-only and V84seed original8/6 linked only for separate alltiles coverage diagnostics.
Keep all U/null and uncertainty out-of-image flags; report FULL/PARTIAL/MISS and all matching tileIDs, never choose best tile or recenter/filter modelinputs.

GT_coverage_definition.FULL: positive-area cue uncertainty half-open box entirely contained by tile half-open window (equality at window high allowed for containment).
GT_coverage_definition.MISSING_REFERENCE_U: reference or uncertainty box null; preserve as U, not MISS or E.
GT_coverage_definition.dual_diagnostics: Float64 continuous box and integer-native-pixel raster uncertainty support computed separately; retain mismatch counts.
GT_coverage_definition.invalid_box: retain/report invalid or zero-area box; fail before changing geometry if present.
GT_coverage_definition.out_of_image: report uncertainty intersects/falls outside native bounds separately; FULL tile does not guarantee visibility or valid source pixels.

tier_KO: 조건부 AI 물리 단서 관찰을 위한 공간 보조 후보 기하다. native8 semantic GT/human gold 또는 실제 training admission이 아니다.
prepared_data_claim: metadata and deterministic geometry only; no actual crop/P3 tensors
